propositions: The runner currently raises an unconditional loud refusal on any base_url/api_key configuration, contradicting documentation that claims both are supported for local endpoints like Ollama and LMStudio.

An openai builder must be registered in the provider factory to construct OpenAIChatModel with base_url/api_key, but only when REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL is set, preserving lazy-string resolution when base_url is absent.

The builder must override the provider's model_profile to withdraw only supports_json_schema_output=False for opaque endpoints, preventing silent wrong answers from servers that lack faithful json_schema implementation.

Configuration validation must replace the loud refusal: check that base_url is an absolute URL, reject api_key without base_url, and provide a clear missing-extra error naming the pydantic-ai-slim[openai] install command.
Bare openai:gpt-4o with no base_url must continue taking pydantic-ai's lazy path, leaving the openai SDK optional at runtime and preserving existing parameterized test behavior.

The ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL non-loopback gateway behavior (already working by accident) must be tested and documented as deliberate, and the openai builder must complete in under 300 LOC to satisfy S1's attested criterion.
